title: However Done
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：however　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 however 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① However, in 1986 the researcher tried the tube at the bench, and everybody in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning: before the February rains the researcher had ② however tried the tube, and nobody had asked a single question. The researcher had come to the lab two terms earlier, and spoke little of the lab he had left behind him.

The paper for February 1980 puts it plainer. The tube was ③ however difficult, and the student who kept it had ④ however tested it twice before the winter came; nothing in the lab was ever done however in those days. The student wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every term thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else. He tried the tube ⑤ however for the whole place, and nobody in the lab doubted it; of all who tried it that term, he tried it ⑥ however year after year. He was not a man who explained himself, and the lab had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was that the tube be tested ⑦ however every term, and that whoever did it be ⑧ however careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done however.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996 she tried the tube ⑨ however year after year when nobody else would, and ⑩ However, she said in 1998, that was the part the lab never forgot; the paper still speaks however of it. She kept the tube in the same bench for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the lab never forgot how however it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 然而（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had however tried …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 然而（修饰形容词：however difficult）
C. adv. 无论如何（评注性状语，置于句首：However, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 无论如何（修饰过去分词：had however tested it）
E. adv. 然而（句末状语：… however for the whole place）
F. adv. 然而（句末状语：… however year after year，第 6 处）
G. adv. 无论如何（被动结构中的中位状语：be tested however）
H. adv. 无论如何（修饰形容词：be however careful about the whole business）

items.q: however for the whole place, and nobody

answers.why: however 意为“然而”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：However, in 1986 …。
however 意为“然而”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had however tried the tube。
however 意为“然而”，此处修饰形容词 difficult（困难）：was however difficult。
however 意为“无论如何”，此处修饰过去分词 tested：had however tested it twice。
however 意为“然而”，此处置于句末修饰动词：tried the tube however for the whole place。
however 意为“然而”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 学期, he did it however year after year。
however 意为“无论如何”，被动结构 be tested however 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
however 意为“无论如何”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be however careful about the whole business。
however 意为“然而”，1996 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次尝试那件细细的试管，副词置于动词之后。
however 意为“无论如何”，母亲 1998 年那句话以评注性状语开头：However, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，研究员无论如何在实验台尝试那件细细的试管；实验室里人人都说那是头一回。（However, …）
雨季到来之前，研究员已经然而尝试那件细细的试管。（had however tried …）
那件细细的试管当时然而困难。（however difficult）
保管它的那位学生在入冬前已经无论如何把它测过两回。（had however tested it）
叔叔然而尝试那件细细的试管，实验室里没有一个人怀疑。（… however …）
在那个学期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最然而。（the most however of all of them）
answers: However, in 1986 the researcher tried the tube at the bench.
Before the February rains the researcher had however tried the tube.
The student who kept it had however tested it twice before the winter came.
He tried the tube however for the whole place, and nobody in the lab doubted it.
Of all who did it that term, he did it however year after year.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: However, in 1986 the researcher tried the tube, and nobody forgot it.
Before the February rains the researcher had however tried the tube.
